# GO1 Actuator MLP Trained with 50Hz Data but Invoked at 200Hz in Simulation Step: What Has Been Verified?

> **Current answer:** The post only verified the invocation of facts, and no fix conclusion has been given. The author added logging in actuator_net.py and manager_based_rl_env.py, and observed the invocation in the official GO1 rough locomotion task, reporting five policy steps per invocation. The team has not answered whether to invoke every four steps, maintain output, or retrain with 200Hz data.
